messages:
julia_sales: OrchID Bio POC needs a signed MSA + order form today for AP cut-off. They attached their procurement template. Key asks: PO on form, SCCs, explicit tenant key isolation statement, and a 30-day 'erase' SLA. Anyone quick?

eric_legal: Share their redline pls. 30-day for all copies is risky; propose split: 30 days for customer data, 90 for backups. Also check if SCCs supersede our DPA or they want to append.

julia_sales: Attached: Orchid_PO_0426.pdf. They appended SCCs and replaced our subproc clause. They also put net45 default.

nicole_procure: We can add PO + billing contact and tax id. Finance prefers net30; net45 needs approval. Are we expecting >$100k ARR?

julia_sales: Target ARR ~110k if converted. I'll flag finance.

peter_sec: For key attestation: we can provide factual language: logical separation, KMS provider, rotation cadence. No per-tenant HSM on hosted. If they insist, offer Private deployment.

eric_legal: Draft attestation to propose: ```
KMS Attestation: Redwood confirms that, in its hosted service, customer encryption keys are logically isolated per customer and managed using industry-standard KMS controls. Keys are not retained in plaintext. This statement is informational and does not create additional contractual liability under the MSA.
```

nicole_procure: I'll build an orderform template with PO field + remit/invoice blocks and set payment terms to net30 pending finance OK for net45.

julia_sales: Sent counter + orderform via DocuSign, asked them to initial any retained redlines to speed closure. envelope created.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood <-> Orchid Bio - MSA & Orderform" (env id: z9y8x7). Recipients: orchid_signer, julia_sales.

orchid (via julia_sales): They viewed, asked whether provisional PO acceptable until finance issues final one. Their AP requires PO on signed docs.

eric_legal: If they require PO on the form, get them to initial redline. Confirm acceptance of 30/90 deletion split and the attestation language to avoid loop.

peter_sec: We'll provide SOC2 redacted on request and current subprocessor schedule link. Questionnaire replies in ~2 business days.

esign-bot: Envelope viewed by orchid_signer at 2109876620.

nicole_procure: Finance approved net45 for this deal size. I'll mark payment terms net45 and include instructions for PO insertion.

esign-bot: Envelope completed at 2109876663. Signed MSA & orderform saved to deals/OrchidBio/2026/attachments.

julia_sales: Great \u2014 adding to CRM and routing to finance for invoice/PO issuance. Thanks team for the quick move. :tada:
